# Antenna selection

<!-- Generated by docs/make_antenna_doc.py from common/parameters.csv, common/layout.py, docs/antenna_runs.csv and rf_model/out. Do not edit by hand: change the inputs and rerun the script. -->

Which antenna to put on each sector, and how far in front of its face. Every value below is read from `common/parameters.csv` or worked out from it, and every result from the committed RF model runs (`rf_model/out`), when `docs/make_antenna_doc.py` last ran.

## Recommendation

**Duck (H50327) at 15 mm.** It has the lowest bearing error of the modelled candidates: 15 deg median, 38 deg at 90%, the right sector 84% of the time. Ranking (median, then 90%):

| # | Candidate | Median | 90% | Right sector |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Duck (H50327) at 15 mm | 15 deg | 38 deg | 83.6% |
| 2 | Duck (H50327) at 31 mm | 15 deg | 40 deg | 80.8% |
| 3 | Stubby monopole at 15 mm | 29 deg | 89 deg | 75.1% |
| 4 | Stubby monopole at 31 mm | 36 deg | 105 deg | 66.3% |

- **Spacing:** 15 mm is never worse than 31 mm for bearing here. For the ducks it is close (15 / 38 against 15 / 40 deg), and 31 mm matches better (S11 -5.0 dB against -2.6 dB at 2440 MHz). For the stubby it is clearly better (29 / 89 against 36 / 105 deg).
- **Antenna type:** a half-wave duck hanging in front of the face beats a quarter-wave stubby by about 1.9x in median error at 15 mm. The stubby uses the deck as its ground plane, so its beam stays broad and tilts down (peak at el -25 deg); the duck's peak is at el 0 deg, straight out from its face.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rubber duck (HiRO H50327) | half-wave sleeve dipole, 108 mm, 2 dBi, RP-SMA | D hole, hanging below the deck in front of the face | modelled |
| Stubby | quarter-wave monopole (shortened, inside a 20.3 mm radome), 28.4 mm end to end, 2 dBi, RP-SMA | D hole, the deck as its ground plane | modelled as a straight wire of the same length |
| Printed fin | printed half-wave dipole on 1 mm FR-4, standing out from the face | the face's centre 6.5 mm hole (`DIPOLE_HOLE`) | its model isn't in this repo yet |
| Patch | flat patch panel | P hole (7 mm off the face, `PATCH_OFFSET`) or P2 | not modelled |

## Results

Bearing simulation setup: fading 5.0 dB/advert, 3 adverts/s, room 3.0 dB, shadow 4.0 dB, window 1 s, mast 1.4 m above the beacon, beacons 1-15 m out, n 2.2.

| Candidate | Spacing | S11 at 2440 MHz | Zin (model) | Peak gain | Peak direction | Isolation | Median | 90% | rms | Right sector | Run |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Duck (H50327) at 15 mm | 15 mm | -2.6 dB | 43 +101j ohm | 8.7 dBi | az 0, el 0 deg | -48 dB | 15 deg | 38 deg | 25 deg | 83.6% | `rf_model/out/rev3_d15_copper_gusset` |
| Duck (H50327) at 31 mm | 31 mm | -5.0 dB | 111 +82j ohm | 8.0 dBi | az 0, el 0 deg | -57 dB | 15 deg | 40 deg | 26 deg | 80.8% | `rf_model/out/rev3_d31_copper_gusset` |
| Stubby monopole at 15 mm | 15 mm | -5.3 dB | 22 +32j ohm | 5.0 dBi | az 0, el -25 deg | -34 dB | 29 deg | 89 deg | 53 deg | 75.1% | `rf_model/out/rev3_d15_copper_stubby` |
| Stubby monopole at 31 mm | 31 mm | -16.4 dB | 59 +14j ohm | 3.9 dBi | az 330, el -25 deg | -29 dB | 36 deg | 105 deg | 61 deg | 66.3% | `rf_model/out/rev3_d31_copper_stubby` |

- Duck (H50327) at 15 mm: half-wave sleeve dipole modelled as a centre-fed dipole, feed DUCK_FEED_DEPTH below the deck; rev 3 copper, end plate.
- Duck (H50327) at 31 mm: as above, 31 mm deck.
- Stubby monopole at 15 mm: modelled as a straight monopole ANT_STUBBY_LENGTH long; the match is the wire's, not the part's.
- Stubby monopole at 31 mm: as above, 31 mm deck.

## Formulas

Speed of light c = 299792458 m/s (the one constant in the script). Frequency f = `RF_FREQ` = 2440 MHz.

| Symbol | Formula | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lambda | c / f | 122.9 mm |
| lambda / 4 | quarter wave (monopole) | 30.7 mm |
| lambda / 2 | half wave (dipole) | 61.4 mm |
| L_mono | 0.95 x lambda / 4 (`sector_model.py` default monopole) | 29.2 mm |
| L_dip | 0.95 x lambda / 2 (`sector_model.py` default dipole) | 58.4 mm |
| duck | ANT_DUCK_LENGTH / lambda | 0.88 lambda |
| stubby | ANT_STUBBY_LENGTH / (lambda / 4) | 0.92 of a quarter wave |
| face | FACE_WIDTH x FACE_H in wavelengths | 0.98 x 0.98 lambda |
| duck feed | DUCK_FEED_DEPTH below the deck (model) | 65 mm |

Per duck spacing d (`DECK_VARIANTS`). AF is the image-theory gain of a vertical element at d in front of an infinite flat reflector, straight out from the face: AF = 2 |sin(2 pi d / lambda)|, in dB 20 log10 AF. It peaks at d = lambda / 4. The real face is finite and the bearing estimate depends on the beam's shape and back rejection, not its peak, so AF explains the trend in gain, not the bearing ranking.

| d | d / lambda | Phase 2 pi d / lambda | AF | AF dB | r_D = r_in + d | D_need | D_deck |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 15 mm | 0.122 | 44 deg | 1.39 | +2.8 dB | 49.64 mm | 114.3 mm | 144.0 mm |
| 31 mm | 0.252 | 91 deg | 2.00 | +6.0 dB | 65.64 mm | 146.3 mm | 146.3 mm |

| Section | Symbol | Formula | Value | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Triangle Core | a | `FACE_WIDTH (side of the triangle)` | 120.00 mm |  |
| Triangle Core | r_in | `a / (2 x sqrt 3)` | 34.64 mm | centre -> face |
| Triangle Core | R_c | `2 x r_in = a / sqrt 3` | 69.28 mm | centre -> corner (circumradius) |
| Triangle Core | h | `FACE_H (face height, below the deck)` | 120.00 mm | make 3 faces a x h |
| Triangle Core | r_core | `r_in - SEAM_STRIP / 2 - CORE_MARGIN` | 30.64 mm | parts and wiring inside the core stay inside this distance from the centre, measured across each face (1 mm clear of the seam) |

## Updating this doc

1. Change values in `common/parameters.csv` (or a build's file), never in the doc.
2. New antenna or spacing: run it with `rf_model/sector_model.py` into a new folder (never over an old one), then `rf_model/bearing_sim.py` with the runs to compare; see `rf_model/README.md`.
3. Add a row to `docs/antenna_runs.csv` (label, antenna, spacing, run folder, bearing folder, notes).
4. `python3 docs/make_antenna_doc.py`, then commit the doc with the runs and the CSV.
